info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Deliveries Status API provides real-time insights into the status of deliveries for food orders. With this endpoint, consumers can query the current statuses of multiple deliveries, ensuring they stay informed about their orders. This API is ideal for restaurants, delivery services, and consumers looking to track food delivery progress efficiently. By leveraging this functionality, users can enhance customer satisfaction and streamline their operational logistics.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of deliveries.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the latest status for all deliveries. It provides insights into the delivery process and helps in tracking the shipments effectively.
